message.subject: Immediate Hiring : Full Stack Transformation Lead/Architect - .NET, React, Python - Richardson, TX - Onsite - W2/1099-USC/GC-Only-No C2C
message.html:
Hi,

 

I hope you’re doing well. I wanted to share a new opportunity that might interest you

 

Full Stack Transformation Lead/Architect – .NET, React, Python

Work Location: Richardson, TX 75082

Assignment Duration: 12 Months contract

 

Number of Openings: 1

 

Relevant Yrs. of experience: 10+

 

Requirements:

•10+ years of experience in application development/architecture

•Strong expertise in .NET Core, React, Python, and microservices

•Experience with legacy modernization and E2E transformation programs

•Familiarity with AI coding tools (Claude/Copilot)

•Strong communication skills; ability to work onsite with client (AMAT)

 

Responsibilities:

•Lead application enhancements and rewrites across 24 apps

•Modernize .NET (MVC to .NET Core), React, and Python applications

•Drive microservices architecture adoption

•Leverage Claude (AI-assisted coding) to improve development productivity

•Provide hands-on technical leadership and collaborate with onsite stakeholders

 

Best Wishes,

Syed Shahnoor Hussain| Lead IT Recruiter|

Email: shahnoor@consultingknights.com  | Consulting Knights, Inc.

Desk: 609-663-8242 / 609-357-9406 Ext 132

100 Overlook Center, 2nd Floor Princeton, New Jersey 08540

 

If you'd prefer not to receive future emails, just reply with "Unsubscribe" and I'll promptly remove you from our list.
